$Comment: What a participant sees and hears the instant a boss falls, with their own part in it.
This is the library's own neutral default; a mod's same-named file or the owner layer
replaces it, and the binding row's Feedback.Defeated leaf can point a fight elsewhere.
The moment fires once per participant the fight credited and carries 'encounter' (the script
id), 'title' (the fight's name in the reader's language), 'members', 'seconds' (how long the
fight took), 'share' (THIS reader's credited share of the fight as whole percent points, the
top contributor reading 100, which is what their loot rolls were scaled by) and 'rank' (their
place, 1 for the top contributor), plus 'participants' and 'source'. 'player' is the
participant it is about. Showing the share is how everyone sees why they got what they got.
Gold Reward tone, because a boss falling is a payout, and a jingle at the reader's own
position. Add a Broadcast (with MinSecondsBetween, since this fires once per participant) to
tell the world; the rewards the fight pays list themselves as rows under the headline on the
